note: Rules for Directions on Norwegian Getaway (1.16.0). Costs are in seconds and set how routes are chosen; tips are the one-line hints under the steps. Edit this file to change them, then run python tools/build_index.py.

tips.text: Elevators are busiest just after arrival. Stairs may be quicker.
Debarkation morning: elevators are packed with luggage. Stairs are usually quicker.
Mealtime at the {place}: {bank} are farther from it and take about as long.
